description: Open-web searches in English and Greek covered month/week and labor, fire, public-gatherings, municipal and transport terms; this is not a systematic LexisNexis archive search. Several local leads remain search-only.
required_followup: A later reviewer may search other local and union archives; no completeness claim.

description: July10 public-gatherings protest is opened and occurred, but no attendance count or qualitative threshold estimate is reported.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous source that counts simultaneous participants, if available.

description: Larnaca bus workers assembled, but the evidence mainly directs their demand to a private operator; ministry confirmation of a violation alone does not prove a government-directed demand.
required_followup: Search for an explicit protest demand on a Cyprus authority/policy.

description: Limassol wildfire rally was followed by a distinct Aug4 Nicosia rally on the same issue; relationship/campaign continuity is not resolved.
required_followup: Compare organizers and campaign linkage from contemporary records without assuming merger.

description: Opened event reports generally do not establish an exact closing time; event end dates remain unknown where not directly stated.
required_followup: Use direct event reporting only; do not default end_date to publication/month end.
